description: Read Microsoft Teams data (every chat and channel, their messages, what is unread, inline images, and the Activity feed) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the microsoft-teams-mcp server. A bearer token is captured once from a signed-in teams.cloud.microsoft tab, then Teams' own chat-service REST API is called with plain curl — the Activity feed included, as conversation 48:notifications. Use when you want Teams data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
